audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a vintage aneroid barometer. The instrument features a circular brass or gold-toned metal casing with a glass cover. The dial face is off-white/cream with black numerical markings (appearing to be in inches of mercury, e.g., 28, 29, 30) and descriptive weather text. There are two pointer hands: a thin black indicator hand and a thicker reference hand. The background is blurred, showing hints of dark wood or furniture.

The elliptical perspective of the rim is mostly correct, but the thickness of the rim varies inconsistently around the circle, suggesting minor geometric warping in the generation process.
